data.name: Aequitas
data.gender_notes: Aequitas is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The quality or state of being just, impartial, or fair. The state of equality, particularly in the distribution of resources or opportunities. The quality of being in harmony or proportion. The name Aequitas carries the meaning “Justice, Equity, Balance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Latin. Parents who choose Aequitas usually hope their child will grow to embody justice, equity, balance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aequitas is a reminder of the balance and harmony in the universe, and the importance of maintaining justice and fairness in our own lives. It is a name that inspires us to seek equilibrium and to treat all beings with kindness and respect.
data.etymology: Aequitas belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Justice, Equity, Balance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aequitas total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: إيكويتاس
in_arabic.meaning: العدالة والمساواة والإنصاف في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: إيكويتاس هو اسم مشتق من اللغة اللاتينية، ومعناه العدالة والمساواة والإنصاف. في السياق الإسلامي، يرتبط هذا الاسم بمفهوم العدل والتوازن في الحياة، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة النحل آية 90: 'إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَى وَيَنْهَى عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ وَالْبَغْيِ'

in_urdu.name: ایکوئٹاس
in_urdu.meaning: عدالت، مساوات اور انصاف کا مطلب
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایکوئٹاس ایک لاطینی اسم ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے عدالت، مساوات اور انصاف۔ اسلامی سیاق و سباق میں، یہ نام زندگی میں توازن اور انصاف کے تصور سے منسلک ہے، جیسا کہ قرآن کریم میں سورة النحل آية 90 میں ذکر ہوا ہے: 'إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَى وَيَنْهَى عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ وَالْبَغْي'

in_hindi.name: एक्विटास
in_hindi.meaning: न्याय, समानता और निष्पक्षता का अर्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: एक्विटास एक लैटिन नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है न्याय, समानता और निष्पक्षता। इस्लामी संदर्भ में, यह नाम जीवन में संतुलन और न्याय की अवधारणा से जुड़ा हुआ है, जैसा कि कुरआन में सूरा अन-नहल आयत 90 में उल्लेख किया गया है: 'इन्नल्लाह यामुरु बिल अद्लि वल इहसानी व इитаए धी القुर्बा व यन्हा अनिल फहशाए वल मुनकरी वल बग्य'

in_pashto.name: ایکویتاس
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایکویتاس د لاتيني ژبې یو نوم دی، چې معنی یې ده عدالت، مساوات او انصاف. په اسلامي سياق کې، دا نوم د ژوند په توګه د توازن او عدالت د مفهوم سره تړلی دی، لکه څنګه چې په قرآن کریم کې د نحل سورت ايت 90 کې ياد شوي دي: 'إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَى وَيَنْهَى عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ وَالْبَغْي'

in_english.name: Aequitas
in_english.meaning: Justice, equality, and fairness in Arabic and Islamic context
in_english.long_meaning: Aequitas is a Latin-derived name meaning justice, equality, and fairness. In Islamic tradition, it relates to the concept of balance and justice in life, as mentioned in the Quran, Surah An-Nahl, verse 90: 'Indeed, Allah enjoins justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and disobedience'

data.cultural_impact: The name "Aequitas" does not have an Islamic origin, being a Latin term for "equity, fairness, and justice." However, the concept of justice, fairness, and equality holds an essential place in Islamic teachings. As a result, the name holds a significant cultural impact within the Islamic community. The name signifies the importance of these ideals and emphasizes their application in social interactions and relationships.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Aequitas" embodies essential aspects of Islamic teachings, reflecting the divine attributes of Allah Almighty. In the Quran, Allah says, "And We have made you an imam for mankind," emphasizing the importance of being a just and fair leader and a model of behavior (Quran 2:30). Aequitas thus holds spiritual significance as a reminder of the importance of upholding justice and fairness in every aspect of life, following the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and striving to please Allah through righteous actions. By living up to the name "Aequitas," one embodies the values of Allah's justice and Muslims aim to live up to these values in all aspects of their lives.
